items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Ed Garland on the bass, Minor Hall on the drums, Ory, and myself. I played up there with them for a long time.

ctx.x: Piano player, yeah. Ed Garland on the bass, Minor Hall on the drums, Ory, and myself. I played up there with them for a long time. And then I left that and I went with Les Hyde, a big band.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I remember that Walter Hall. But, uh, let's see. Walter Hall. Ram Hall. Yeah, he's a drummer. Baby Hall.
Call him, call him Chubby Hall.
